errors.evidence: The machine-generated description does not mention the title or purpose of the chart, which is to show the labor productivity for the industry sector in Bulgaria (Производителност на труда за сектор „Индустрия“ за Р. България).
The description states that the x-axis labels are slanted ('изписани под наклон'), but they are horizontal in the figure.

errors.text_span: отбелязва лек спад между 2009 г. (18537.8) и 2010 г. (18329.6)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly describes a dip in the blue line. The values cited, 18537.8 and 18329.6, do not correspond to the blue line's data for 2009 and 2010. The value 18537.8 is from the orange line in 2009, and 18329.6 is the blue line's value for 2011. The actual blue line values are 13282.9 for 2009 and 15819.9 for 2010, which represents a dip followed by a recovery, not a continuous decline between the two years.

errors.text_span: достига най-високата си стойност от 28092.1 през 2017 година и завършва със спад на 27338.8 в края на оста през 2018 година
errors.evidence: This part of the description correctly describes the blue line, but it is incorrectly associated with the preceding clause which used values from the orange line. The description as a whole is confusing because it starts describing the blue line's dip with orange line values and then switches back to correct blue line values.
